decks.notes: The deck revolves around creating a synergistic combo using Amalia Benavides Aguirre and various support cards to gain life and control the board. It includes cards like Lively Dirge, Collected Company, and Return to the Ranks to help assemble the combo pieces quickly. The deck also leverages cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Chord of Calling for additional utility and flexibility. The main focus is on utilizing Amalia's abilities to generate value and gain life while setting up for a powerful finish with Aetherflux Reservoir.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to play small, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Aloe Alchemist, and then use pump spells like Monstrous Rage and Atarka's Command to deal massive damage quickly. Reckless Bushwhacker and Burning-Tree Emissary provide additional burst of damage, while cards like Break Out and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance help to maintain pressure and control the board. The deck aims to finish the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Aetherflux Reservoir, and other creatures like Wildgrowth Walker and Temple Garden. By using cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling, the deck aims to gain life, generate mana, and create a board state that allows for a massive life gain and direct damage combo with Aetherflux Reservoir. The deck also includes protective elements like Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition to ensure the combo can go off successfully.

The main concept of this deck is to focus on building up a strong board presence by ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also utilizing green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to quickly overwhelm the opponent. This deck also includes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Outcaster Trailblazer for additional support and card advantage. The goal is to quickly establish control of the battlefield and deal consistent damage to the opponent with an aggressive playstyle.

This deck focuses on utilizing the life gain synergies of Amalia Benavides Aguirre along with cards like Wildgrowth Walker, Prosperous Innkeeper, and Return to the Ranks to gain a substantial life advantage. The deck also includes a variety of utility creatures and spells like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for specific combo pieces or answers as needed. With the ability to generate a large amount of life quickly, the deck aims to stabilize and overwhelm opponents with resilient threats while also being able to close out games with Aetherflux Reservoir.

The deck aims to assemble a powerful life-gain combo utilizing cards like Aetherflux Reservoir, Collected Company, and Wildgrowth Walker. By gaining life and generating tokens with cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Amalia Benavides Aguirre, the deck can quickly build up a massive life total and then finish off the opponent with Aetherflux Reservoir's ability. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Skyclave Apparition provide additional utility and disruption, allowing the deck to survive against opposing removal spells and disruptive strategies.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and various artifacts to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive plays. By combining cards like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast with creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Spyglass Siren, the deck aims to deal damage efficiently and effectively. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck, allowing for a strong and streamlined game plan. The deck thrives on quick tempo plays and strategic positioning to seize control of the game.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, supported by burn spells and combat tricks to deal damage efficiently. By playing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with pump spells like Monstrous Rage and Atarka's Command, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero before they have a chance to set up their own game plan. The inclusion of lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins also adds extra reach and versatility to the deck's aggressive strategy.

The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. It utilizes powerful vampire synergies with Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Bloodtithe Harvester, while also including removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Archfiend of the Dross and Vein Ripper adds additional threats to the board, while Thoughtseize and Duress help disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck is designed to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up devotion to green through aggressive plays and efficient ramping with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. This allows for explosive turns where cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll can come down early and overwhelm the opponent. Supplementing this strategy are cards like Invasion of Ixalan and Storm the Festival to further push the advantage, with Leyline of the Guildpact providing additional support for the green devotion theme. The deck aims to establish a dominant board presence and overpower the opponent before they can react effectively.

This Spirit Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a small but efficient creature base backed up by disruptive spells and utility lands. By combining cheap and evasive spirits with tempo plays such as Spell Queller and Shacklegeist, the deck can disrupt opponents while chipping away at their life total. The deck also includes cards like Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr and Wedding Announcement to help boost the team and provide resilience against removal. The key is to maintain pressure while disrupting opponents' game plan.

This deck focuses on leveraging the power of Spirit creatures to quickly overwhelm and defeat opponents. By playing aggressively with flying creatures like Spectral Sailor, Mausoleum Wanderer, and Shacklegeist, while supporting them with cards like Rattlechains and Supreme Phantom, the goal is to establish an early advantage and maintain pressure. Ascendant Spirit can grow into a powerful threat to seal the deal. Utilizing control elements like Spell Pierce and Geistlight Snare helps protect the aggro game plan. Additionally, Faceless Haven provides additional evasion, while Brazen Borrower and Cryptic Coat offer versatile options for disrupting opponents.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on disruption and efficient removal spells to control the game while using creatures with evasion and lifegain to push through damage and outvalue the opponent. It aims to pressure the opponent early and close out the game before they can stabilize, utilizing a mix of hand disruption, removal, and powerful threats to stay ahead and win through attrition and tempo advantage. The deck also has some recursion and card advantage engines to grind out longer games if necessary.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes powerful cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to put pressure on the opponent, while also including disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some powerful late-game threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet as additional win conditions. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on a Rakdos Aggro strategy, utilizing creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and keep the opponent on the back foot. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional support for the aggressive creatures, while cards like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse offer powerful late-game threats. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and aggressive, while still having options for longer games with its powerful creatures.

The primary focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while efficiently removing threats with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck also aims to maintain aggressive pressure with creatures such as Bloodtithe Harvester, Dusk Legion Zealot, and Archfiend of the Dross. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to boost the power of its vampire creatures and provide additional value. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruption, removal, and aggressive threats.
